_doc: Recorded autonomy grants for the Supervisor (FOC-613). A grant is a standing operator decision the Supervisor may act on without re-asking, within that grant's own `scope`, and never for anything in `neverCovers` — the loader (scripts/autonomy-grants.mjs) refuses a grant naming a neverCovers action at load time. Grants are consulted where the decision is enforced, not as a general licence: today that is supervisor-cleanup.mjs `remove`, which accepts the `cleanup-own-worktree` grant as a stand-in for the cleanup-approval gate when the landed proof holds. How a grant weighs against a live instruction is the precedence ladder in agents/supervisor/CLAUDE.md (<precedence_policy>). A recorded prohibition ("no push", "children never push") is NOT a grant and must not be recorded here — prohibitions are enforced, grants are permissions.

grants.source: Operator decision cf4c, 2026-09-28 — local landing on main within the Supervisor gate flow is RATIFIED.

Operator directive krok0, 2026-09-29, verbatim: "DECYDUJESZ SAM: sprzątanie wyłącznie własnych worktrees i branchy `la-merge/*` w całości obecnych w main". The recorded scope is deliberately narrower than the quote's la-merge clause: la-merge/* branch pruning is a separate task and is not built here, and no foc-*-review branch is covered — review trees always go through the cleanup-approval gate. Scope semantics enforced by the consumer: repo and branch must match the patterns, the tree must sit in the spawn worktree root (a Supervisor-owned tree, not one made by hand), the tree must be clean, and the landed proof must hold — branch and worktree HEAD both ancestors of main.
